Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The initial code incorrectly used an Authorization: Bearer header for the MediaWiki Action API (unnecessary for public read requests) and omitted proper pagination via rvcontinue. This misuse of the API set the team on a flawed path, triggering authorization errors and prompting a misguided focus on token acquisition. As the loop entry with a core data misuse, it was the first decisive step that made recovering the correct approach difficult.
